WHYME.TITLE: Why me
WHYME.TEXT: I’m a junior fullstack developer focused on Angular on the frontend and Django/Python on the backend. This portfolio shows the real path: from a 2D game to Join to a delivery app with API, web portal and mobile. I build with structure, think in components and learn fast – frontend, backend and everything in between.

SKILLS.TITLE: My Skills
SKILLS.LEARNING_TEXT: Besides Angular and Django I also explore other frontend frameworks like React and Vue.js.

POINTS.TITLE: About the project
POINTS.TEXT: This is a fun jump & run game made with vanilla JavaScript.

POINTS.TITLE: How I have organised my work process
POINTS.TEXT: Game logic was modularized into classes and cleanly separated.

POINTS.TITLE: My group work experience
POINTS.TEXT: Solo project with mentoring, focused on OOP and animations.

POINTS.TITLE: About the project
POINTS.TEXT: Join as a fullstack Kanban app: Angular frontend, Django REST API, PostgreSQL – login, board, tasks, contacts, notifications and i18n.

POINTS.TITLE: How I have organised my work process
POINTS.TEXT: UI and API stay separate, with Docker and a real database instead of Firebase.

POINTS.TITLE: My group work experience
POINTS.TEXT: Built on from the team Join: frontend and backend as one deployable product.

GALLERY.TITLE: Kanban board
GALLERY.TEXT: To do, In progress, Await feedback, Done. Angular only talks to the Django REST API; tasks live in PostgreSQL.

GALLERY.TITLE: Fullstack split
GALLERY.TEXT: Navigation on the left (Summary, Add Task, Board, Contacts), board on the right – frontend and API are separate containers.

POINTS.TITLE: About the project
POINTS.TEXT: Delivery management for Rheinpfalz and Wochenblatt: Django API, Angular web portal and Ionic app for routes, complaints, vacations and newspaper boxes.

POINTS.TITLE: How I have organised my work process
POINTS.TEXT: Roles are split (carrier vs. office), shared REST API, route guards and reusable components.

POINTS.TITLE: My group work experience
POINTS.TEXT: Independent fullstack project with a clear split between backend, web portal and mobile.

GALLERY.TITLE: Admin dashboard
GALLERY.TEXT: Office view: complaints, vacation, sickness rate, Rheinpfalz and Wochenblatt – Angular portal on the Django API.

GALLERY.TITLE: Roles & modules
GALLERY.TEXT: Sidebar: complaints, districts, routes & map, tickets. Carriers see a different menu, same API.
